verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships first-party assistants a user can hand tasks to. The `clai` CLI lets you chat with LLMs from the terminal or a browser-based server, and the docs describe a complete terminal coding agent with workspace-rooted file access, an allowlisted shell, planning and long-session context management. Any agent can also be launched directly via `Agent.to_cli_sync()`. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the coding agent's task-delegation workflow beyond overview claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the built-in assistant itself.
